model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss values over the course of training iterations for six different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” is linearly scaled from 0 to 140,000 iterations, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is linearly scaled from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six distinct lines: the purple line labeled “Vanilla” starts at a loss of approximately 3.4 and decreases to about 2.5; the blue line labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)” begins near 3.4 and settles around 2.7; the orange line labeled “SepLLM (n=64)” starts near 3.4 and stabilizes around 2.6; the green line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)” begins at approximately 3.3 and ends near 2.5; the red line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” starts at roughly 3.3 and ends near 2.5; and the dark blue line labeled “SepLLM (n=128)” begins near 3.4 and stabilizes around 2.6. All lines exhibit a downward trend in loss over iterations, with the green and red lines showing the most rapid initial decrease before leveling off.
